from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df1, df2, column1="feature1", column2="feature2"):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    if column1 not in df1.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Column '{column1}' not found in df1.")
    if column2 not in df2.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Column '{column2}' not found in df2.")

    left = df1.copy()
    right = df2.copy()

    feature1_name = "__task_feature1__"
    feature2_name = "__task_feature2__"

    left = left.rename(columns={column1: feature1_name})
    right = right.rename(columns={column2: feature2_name})

    merge_keys = [c for c in df1.columns if c in df2.columns and c not in {column1, column2}]

    if merge_keys:
        merged = pd.merge(left, right, on=merge_keys, how="inner")
    else:
        left = left.reset_index(drop=True)
        right = right.reset_index(drop=True)
        left["__merge_key__"] = np.arange(len(left))
        right["__merge_key__"] = np.arange(len(right))
        merged = pd.merge(left, right, on="__merge_key__", how="inner").drop(columns="__merge_key__")

    if feature1_name not in merged.columns or feature2_name not in merged.columns:
        raise KeyError("Required feature columns are missing after merging.")

    X_df = merged[[feature1_name, feature2_name]].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")
    valid_mask = np.isfinite(X_df.to_numpy(dtype=float)).all(axis=1)
    X_df = X_df.loc[valid_mask]
    X = X_df.to_numpy(dtype=float)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if len(X) == 0:
        labels = np.empty(0, dtype=np.int32)
        ax.scatter([], [])
    elif len(X) == 1:
        labels = np.zeros(1, dtype=np.int32)
        ax.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=labels, cmap="viridis", s=30)
    else:
        kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=2, n_init=10, random_state=0)
        labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X).astype(np.int32, copy=False)
        ax.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=labels, cmap="viridis", s=30)

    ax.set_xlabel(column1)
    ax.set_ylabel(column2)

    return labels, ax
